text: I contacted the company on XX/XX/2024 regarding an alleged debt which has been furnished to XXXX XXXX, XXXX, and XXXX, that is damaging my credit worthiness, general character, and reputation. I never gave any expressed written consent to the company to obtain, compile, store, share, or distribute my personal private information. I contacted the company and spoke with XXXX in Texas to resolve the matter ; I mentioned that I sent a notice and demand for Debt Validation pursuant to Fair Debt Collections Practices Act and she admitted that it was received. Unfortunately, I have not received any correspondence by XXXX Mail. The company is in default and has failed to respond.
